tickets.title: Update snapshot tests for new syntax highlighting output
tickets.description: Regenerate snapshot test files to reflect changes in CSS class naming and rendering output due to tree-sitter v0.25.0 update

implementation_summary:
The implementation involved updating the tree-sitter dependency from its current version to v0.25.0, which introduced a breaking API change where the `Query.captures` method was moved to `QueryCursor.captures`. This required refactoring the syntax highlighting code in Textual's TextArea widget to use the new API pattern. Additionally, since tree-sitter v0.24.0+ requires Python 3.10 or higher, the minimum Python version for syntax highlighting features had to be updated accordingly.

The changes are reflected in the snapshot test file which shows updated CSS class names. The original class names like `terminal-2526263208-matrix` have been simplified to `terminal-matrix`, and similar changes apply to all CSS classes and clipPath IDs. This suggests that the syntax highlighting implementation now generates more deterministic or simplified class names, possibly due to changes in how tree-sitter processes and tokenizes code for highlighting.

The update maintains backward compatibility for users not using syntax highlighting features while ensuring that Textual can leverage the latest improvements in tree-sitter's parsing capabilities. The snapshot test update was necessary because the rendered output of syntax-highlighted code changed slightly due to the tree-sitter update, and tests needed to reflect the new expected output to prevent false test failures.
